_meta.what: The labels v1.289.0 (PR #435) took out of clip titles that are NO clip's `by` or `channel` value: series, shows, tags, handles, web addresses, short forms and the gym 10th Planet. scripts/check_no_names.py refuses any of them in a clip title or a credit line (whole-word, case-insensitive; never prose, never JSON-LD), prints how many it holds and fails on an empty list.
_meta.count: Each label's number is how many of the PR's 208 distinct rewritten titles (277 clip rows) it was removed from: the old title holds it and the new one does not.
_meta.rule: A RATCHET, not a detector. Add a label when a title loses one; never add a word a technique, position or submission is named by (the London, Kimura, De La Riva, the Matrix). A label that a real title needs comes off BY HAND, with its reason in not_held.
_meta.checked: Every label against the graph's names and aliases (every content record's name, aliases, display_title and file name, and graph.json's node names: positions, transitions, submissions, principles, learning): none equals one, none is inside one, and none is in any current clip title. Two are inside the names of Systems guides, which are named for a gym's or a team's system and are never printed in a clip title or a credit line: {"10th Planet": ["10th Planet Half Guard Bottom System", "10th Planet No-Gi Guard System", "10th Planet Rubber Guard System"], "B-Team": ["B-Team Dilemma System"]}.

not_held.UFC: 2 titles. A competition that describes the video; one current title keeps it on purpose ("from a UFC finish")
not_held.The Base: 1 title. Base is a graph name, and the words are ordinary
not_held.Jiu Jitsu Matrix: 1 title. It holds the name of a technique, the Matrix
not_held.The EDGE: 1 title. Ordinary words: a title can say "the edge" of the mat
not_held.Best BJJ Takedowns: 1 title. Ordinary words that can describe a video
not_held.a part of a person's or gym's name: 3 titles ("by Gracie…" twice, "The Gentle…"). A part of a name is not a label; persons by surname are the next check's (a names lexicon with the eponyms masked)
not_held.words cut or re-worded by hand that name: 6 titles ("Famous", "Camp -", "Seminar -", "With BJJ Champion!", and two titles only re-worded). Not labels

_meta.recompute: The candidates are the removed names in the PR's own title table; the builder and the measurement are scratch scripts, named in docs/Changelog-Archive.md's v1.289.0 entry. To re-measure by hand: for each old title of `git diff 175002147 555d0e30f -- content`, call check_no_names.hit() and label_hit().
_meta.measured: Of the PR's 208 distinct rewritten titles, each put back: the name list alone flags 53, the name list and these labels 193. The 15 that still pass are the not_held rows (2+1+1+1+1+3+6).
